content:
Heard a thought experiment by David Zelman on the Behind the Human podcast that resonated. 

D: Put your hand on your head
M: *does so*
D: Thanks you can take it off. Now why did you do that?
M: because you asked me too 
D: If I asked you to take all the books off your bookshelf and throw them around the room would you do it?
M: Likely not
D: See it has nothing to do with me asking. You tell yourself what to do moment by moment by moment. There's an internal conversation that happens telling you what to do and the insight is that you can change that conversation by instructing yourself to have thoughts that are more productive.

I'm recognizing how important agency is to me. Probably my top value
